known_limitations: Only local sender and controlled durable Delivery peer are qualified. No live IAM/BFF/Delivery implementation, provider credentials, ClickUp create/readback, observations or production runtime fencing.
Runtime must supply current-authority/epoch workspace roster, shared actual-start boundary and existing bounded worker pool. All are explicit ports; no startup is enabled by default.
A fresh known workspace is indexed in a scoped worker transaction; global job discovery exposes only IDs and due/lease metadata. Sender is sequential bounded RunScope, no unbounded Go workers.
Expired/held/conflicting work is not regenerated; no fresh identity, financial re-decision, sliding TTL or inference of missing external effect from lease expiry.
SQL ACKED means durable controlled Delivery receipt; case remains WORKING/UNESTABLISHED. No provider success or whole MVP qualification.
Process exits/HTTP and commit ACK loss tested, not physical power loss, deployment RPO, long-window availability, load or production credentials.
